title: Native BEST AUTO PARRY
features:
✨ CONFIGURATION ✨

⚔️ [ COMBAT ]

- 🛡️ Auto Parry  
  - Self explanatory.

- 💎 Perfect Parry  
  - Quite literally perfect, though ping may affect the timing.

- ⚡ Auto-Spam Parry  
  - Detects a range that activates auto-spam for better parry quality.

- 🔥 Auto-Ability  
  - Casts a deflecting ability if you miss a parry and the ball is about to hit you.

- 🧠 Prediction Mode  
  - 🎯 Deflect  
    - Deflects the ball using perfect prediction.  
      (When a player aims their camera at you, predicts a parry when the ball is passed.)

  - 🔮 Pre-Deflect  
    - Deflects the ball in a predictable way.  
      (Triggers parry when a player aims at you before they parry.)  

--------------------------------------------------

🃏 [ CARD – Market ]

- 🛒 Auto Card [Purchase]  
  - Automatically buys the selected card.

- 🍎 Auto Fruit [Purchase & Use]  
  - Automatically buys and uses the selected fruit.

- 🗑️ Auto Sword [Delete]  
  - Automatically deletes the selected sword.

--------------------------------------------------

👑 [ BOSS – Main ]

- 🤖 Auto Farm  
  - Execute inside the boss teleport area (not the lobby).

--------------------------------------------------

🎮 [ MISC – Main ]

- 🕶️ Hide Identity  
  - Hides your username (bottom right & leaderboard [Tab]).

- 🚀 Auto Join  
  - Automatically steps on the ready pad to join a match.

- 🎴 Claim All Jiro Cards  
  - Cards must be present in the map/place to be claimed.
